I couldn't reproduce or fix any of the five reds. The command that runs a slice, `slicechk.sh`, was refused for this worker, so I couldn't run it. It isn't on the allowed command list, which has only shipq, shipdraft, fixq, genP, runchk, lock, unlock and clearstale.

The only other way to run a check is `runchk`, and that runs each check alone, which is how these five already pass. So I changed nothing and guessed no fix.

I wrote the block into `tools/handoff/console/notes/58b-corpus-harness-reds.md` and added a line to `alarms.md`. To unblock this, either allow `slicechk.sh` for lane a workers, or run the bisect `slicechk.sh a 120:152,152` yourself and name the check that leaves state behind.
